sources.title: UNESCO · Similipal Biosphere Reserve
sources.note: UNESCO, Man and the Biosphere Programme: “General information” and “Ecological Characteristics.” River systems and vegetation; not a visitor opening notice.
sources.inspection: Actual UNESCO profile read on 20 October 2026, General information and Ecological Characteristics. Existing research source reused under a scoped destination key. Excluded inconsistent area units, rankings, species totals and generalised community claims.

sources.title: UNESCO · Chhau dance
sources.note: UNESCO, Chhau dance, inscription 00337 (2010): regional styles and movement vocabulary. The inscription covers all three styles.
sources.inspection: Existing inscription evidence reused; fresh official indexed description inspected on 20 October 2026. Direct page presented a verification barrier which was not bypassed. Shared inscription of three styles, not exclusive Odisha recognition, current performance schedule or definitive origin history.

sources.title: Battery Dance · 15 August 2024 programme
sources.note: Battery Dance, 15 August 2024 programme: The Chhau Samagam, Natraj and credits. Presenter’s description, not an eyewitness account.
sources.inspection: Actual programme introduction, Natraj notes and credits read on 20 October 2026. Presenter description, not witnessed performance or independently confirmed delivery. Excluded erroneous geography and superlatives.

sources.title: Ministry of Culture · Pandit Raghunath Murmu, Digital District Repository
sources.note: Ministry of Culture, Digital District Repository, 9 June 2022: Dandbose, Rairangpur and Murmu’s songs, plays and schoolbooks.
sources.inspection: Existing 9 June 2022 Digital District Repository entry reused; fresh indexed text supports Dandbose, Rairangpur, songs, plays and schoolbooks. Direct retrieval failed. No invented childhood quotations, unverified synopsis or claim that the script created the language.

sources.title: President of India · Santali Writers’ Association literary festival, Baripada
sources.note: President’s Secretariat, 20 November 2023, paragraphs 1 and 4: the Baripada literary festival and Murmu’s named plays; not their plots.
sources.inspection: Actual President’s Secretariat release dated 20 November 2023 read on 20 October 2026, paragraphs 1 and 4–5. Institutional record of the Baripada gathering and address. No play-text analysis, current festival schedule or broad community generalisation adopted.

sources.title: Odisha Tourism · Baripada
sources.note: Odisha Tourism, Baripada, “Local Food and Cuisine”: Mudi Mangsa. Describes a mutton version; the photograph’s chicken variation is separately credited.
sources.inspection: Actual current destination page read on 20 October 2026, Local Food & Cuisine: Mudi Mangsa. Describes a mutton version, not every preparation or a restaurant inspection. Current October–March seasonal guidance differs from the old November–April page; no seasonal or transport claims adopted.

sources.title: Similipal Tiger Reserve · Compliance and Guidelines
sources.note: Similipal Tiger Reserve, “Compliance and Guidelines,” checked 20 October 2026: drones, noise, routes, stopping points and food. Check separate opening notices.
sources.inspection: Actual guidelines text and TLS-valid page capture inspected on 20 October 2026. The search index contained a 1 November 2026 reopening announcement, but direct text omitted it; the article does not adopt that date or assert current opening. The old /pages/plan-your-visit URL returned 404.

sources.title: Mayurbhanj district · Handicraft
sources.note: Mayurbhanj district, “Handicraft,” Sabai Grass Product section: ropes and household objects. This is not a maker or visit endorsement.
sources.inspection: Existing district source and fresh indexed Sabai Grass Product section inspected on 20 October 2026; direct retrieval failed. General craft description, not current production, income, training or producer endorsement.
